scope: Read-only audit of non-frozen planner path: engine/app/product/server.py only.

compose_sys_problematic_phrases.phrase: Both errors are equally bad and must both be avoided
compose_sys_problematic_phrases.why: Symmetric framing invites the LLM to hedge. Wrong-bind and over-ask are NOT symmetric: a draft is reversible, an unsent clarify is a dead loop. Prompt should bias toward act when count==1.

compose_sys_problematic_phrases.phrase: Picking one of several equally-fitting candidates (guessing) is a misattribution = the worst outcome.
compose_sys_problematic_phrases.why: Calling guessing 'the worst outcome' (repeated twice) sets a salience asymmetry the prompt then claims is symmetric. LLMs in doubt will default to the loss-aversion side -> clarify.

compose_sys_problematic_phrases.phrase: Resolving a generic person-less 'the lathe restoration' here is a GUESS = the worst outcome.
compose_sys_problematic_phrases.why: Second 'worst outcome' framing in 20 lines. Reinforces clarify-default. The single-person example R10/R12/R17 should be the more prominent worked example, not the multi-person trap.

compose_sys_problematic_phrases.phrase: STEP 1 - List the CANDIDATE referents... PER-PERSON INSTANCES (critical)
compose_sys_problematic_phrases.why: Long, dense procedural rules upfront. By the time the model reaches 'A single clear referent MUST be resolved' (line 5163-5164), context dilution makes the loss-averse default win. Move the count==1 -> act rule to the TOP, before the multi-candidate trap.

compose_sys_problematic_phrases.phrase: Email ADDRESS resolution is NOT your job
compose_sys_problematic_phrases.why: Correct directive but buried at the bottom. Pronoun-only triggers (R12 'She is waiting on those notes.', R17 'I should send her the schedule') fail because the model treats the lack of a name as needing clarification rather than reaching to recent transcript context.

finalize_plan_observations: Lines 3711-3818: _finalize_plan ALREADY contains three layered clarify->act promotions (addr_clarify salvage at 3719, dossier salvage at 3737, named-recipient salvage at 3785). Strong machinery but it only activates if plan.intent is email-ish OR plan already says clarify-with-address-question.

EMPTY_MODE plans (mode='clarify', question='Which one did you mean?', _infra_fallback=True) from line 5454 BYPASS all three salvages because plan.intent is '' and the question text contains 'mean' (not 'address'). Add an _infra_fallback branch in _finalize_plan that re-runs _resolve_person_from_active_dossier + recent-transcript pronoun resolution before returning the generic clarify.
No demote act->clarify path exists post-LLM (good). The ambiguity_guard at line 3708 only acts on the LLM's own decision, not promoting clarify->act.

Lines 3806-3814 hard-codes 'Which email address should I use?' as the fallback question. For R12/R17 pattern (pronoun + no name token) this is the wrong question; the real missing slot is the antecedent, not the address.

pronoun_fastpath_proposal.rule: In _fastpath_plan_from_memory, when matched_names==0 (no dossier name in the trigger text) AND text contains a pronoun (her/him/them/she/he/they) AND the recent transcript window (last 2-3 lines from _recent_transcripts) contains exactly one dossier person whose pronoun matches via the dossier's pronoun field (or gender hint via first-name-to-gender table), emit mode=act resolving to that person. Fall through to LLM only if 0 or 2+ pronoun-compatible dossier people sit in the recent window.
pronoun_fastpath_proposal.rationale: R10, R12, R13, R15, R16, R17, R18, R19 all use 'her' with exactly one female (Priya OR Maya) in the immediately prior context line. R11/R14/R20 use 'her' explicitly + a name. The pronoun-only ones currently force a 30s+ LLM round-trip with high CLARIFY_REFLEX rate; deterministic pronoun resolution catches them in <5ms.

r12_scenario_text: Context: 'Priya asked me to write up the pricing exploration.' Trigger: 'She is waiting on those notes.' Expected: Priya Shah.
r17_scenario_text: Context: 'Our operations partner Maya needs the payroll schedule.' Trigger: 'I should send her the schedule before next pay run.' Expected: Maya Chen.
diagnosis: Both triggers (a) contain no dossier first-name token so _fastpath_plan_from_memory returns None at line 5326 (matched_names != 1, since matched_names is empty), AND (b) use a third-person pronoun ('she'/'her') whose antecedent sits in the PRECEDING context line, not the trigger itself. The LLM must do two-step pronoun resolution against the recent window. R17 ran 89.5s and R12 51.9s before returning empty/garbage mode — model timed out trying to resolve. The _infra_fallback at line 5454 then returns mode='clarify' question='Which one did you mean?' which is logged as EMPTY_MODE by the test. Pronoun resolution is a deterministic problem the LLM should never see.

top_3_recommended_edits.change_summary: Extend _fastpath_plan_from_memory with a pronoun-resolution branch: when no name token matches, scan the trigger for {she, her, hers, he, him, his, they, them, their}; if exactly one dossier person whose pronoun matches sits in the last 3 _recent_transcripts entries, return an act plan bound to that person. Use dossier .pronoun field when present; else infer from first-name table (Priya->she, Maya->she, Dana->she, Marcus->he, etc.) loaded from a small static map.
top_3_recommended_edits.expected_impact: Resolves R12, R17 deterministically; also pre-empts R10, R16 CLARIFY_REFLEX (both use 'her' with single female in context). Projected resolvable PASS lift from current pattern: 4 of the 4 residual non-TIMEOUT failures.

top_3_recommended_edits.change_summary: Rewrite _COMPOSE_SYS to lead with the count==1->act rule as a one-liner ('If exactly one candidate person fits, mode=act. Period.'), drop the symmetric 'both errors equally bad' framing, and remove the duplicated 'worst outcome' language. Keep the multi-candidate clarify rule but as a single short paragraph after the act rule. Add a worked example: 'memory: Priya (she/her) pricing notes; trigger She is waiting -> mode=act, person=Priya, intent=email_draft.'
top_3_recommended_edits.expected_impact: Reduces CLARIFY_REFLEX on R10, R16 and similar single-female-pronoun triggers when the fastpath misses (e.g., dossier missing pronoun field). Trims prompt by ~30 lines, lowering p95 LLM latency a bit too.

top_3_recommended_edits.change_summary: Add an _infra_fallback branch at the top of _finalize_plan: if plan.get('_infra_fallback') is True, run _resolve_person_from_active_dossier(instruction) AND a pronoun-against-recent-window resolver before returning the generic 'Which one did you mean?' clarify. On single deterministic match, promote to mode=act email_draft.
top_3_recommended_edits.expected_impact: Last-line defense for EMPTY_MODE plans (R12, R17 today). Even if the LLM times out or returns garbage, deterministic pronoun + dossier resolution kicks in instead of asking the user.
